Jio-bp, a collaboration between Reliance Industries Limited and bp, is rapidly expanding its electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure across India under the brand Jio-bp Pulse. Charging Infrastructure and Accessibility

Jio-bp Pulse offers a comprehensive charging network compatible with various EVs, including two-wheelers, three-wheelers, four-wheelers, and electric buses. Charging stations are strategically located in public parking areas, hotels, shopping malls, residential societies, petrol pumps, and airports, ensuring accessibility for a broad user base. ￼

User Experience and Pricing

The Jio-bp Pulse Charge App facilitates seamless, cashless transactions, accepting multiple payment methods such as net banking, credit cards, debit cards, UPI, and digital wallets. Users can locate, book, pay for, and monitor their charging sessions through the app. ￼
